units.title: B1 Listening Comprehension & Audio Task Strategies

lessons.title: B1 Listening: Short Announcements & Monologues
grammar: Imperatives and modal verbs for instructions (must, should)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-001"
cando: "Can extract key factual details from short public announcements and monologues."
strategy: "Timing: 1-2 mins per clip (played twice). Pitfall: Choosing options with matching words that alter context. Criteria: Detail comprehension and distractor avoidance."
lessons.recycled: Foundational communication & basic level vocabulary

lessons.title: B1 Listening: Transactional Conversations & Multiple Choice
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-002"
cando: "Can understand main points and agreement in short transactional conversations."
strategy: "Timing: 2 mins per dialogue. Pitfall: Focus on first speaker before full agreement is reached. Criteria: Identifying consensus and speaker intention."
lessons.recycled: Imperatives and modal verbs for instructions, Time prepositions, Platform, Announcement

lessons.title: B1 Listening: Note Completion & Gap Fill
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-003"
cando: "Can listen to an informational talk and complete missing notes with exact words."
strategy: "Timing: 5 mins listening + note filling. Pitfall: Misspelling common numbers or dates. Criteria: Spelling accuracy and concise factual extraction."
lessons.recycled: Present continuous for current activities, Indirect questions, Reservation, Schedule

lessons.title: B1 Listening: Extended Talk & Interview Comprehension
grammar: Connectors of cause and effect (because, so)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-004"
cando: "Can follow a 6-minute radio interview and identify speaker opinions and facts."
strategy: "Timing: 6 mins total audio duration. Pitfall: Confusing speaker's past feelings with present attitude. Criteria: Global gist and attitude tracking."
lessons.recycled: Past simple for completed events, Cardinal and ordinal numbers, Registration, Location

lessons.title: B1 Listening: Full Audio Strategy Review & Timed Drill
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-005"
cando: "Can complete a full 30-minute B1 listening section with exam timing."
strategy: "Timing: Strict 30-minute timed section. Pitfall: Spending too long on missed items instead of moving forward. Criteria: Overall listening accuracy under timed test conditions."
lessons.recycled: Present perfect with for/since, Connectors of cause and effect, Background, Experience

units.title: B1 Reading Comprehension & Use of English

lessons.title: B1 Reading: Notices, Signs & Short Messages
grammar: Modal verbs of obligation and permission (must, can, allowed to)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-006"
cando: "Can read public notices and messages to understand real-world rules and warnings."
strategy: "Timing: 45 seconds per notice. Pitfall: Misinterpreting negative permissions (must not vs don't have to). Criteria: Rapid scanning and paraphrase recognition."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of B1 listening structures, Reported speech, Transcript, Distractor

lessons.title: B1 Reading: Informational Text Matching & Profiles
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-007"
cando: "Can match 5 person profiles with appropriate short informational descriptions."
strategy: "Timing: 8 mins total. Pitfall: Matching a description that satisfies only 2 out of 3 user criteria. Criteria: Multi-condition matching accuracy."
lessons.recycled: Modal verbs of obligation, Zero conditional for rules, Prohibited, Mandatory

lessons.title: B1 Reading: Multiple-Choice Text Analysis & Gist
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-008"
cando: "Can read a 400-word article to answer multiple-choice questions on main ideas and writer opinion."
strategy: "Timing: 10 mins for text and 5 questions. Pitfall: Choosing options that reflect personal beliefs rather than text facts. Criteria: Identifying explicit text evidence."
lessons.recycled: Comparative structures, Relative pronouns, Requirement, Suitable

lessons.title: B1 Use of English: Gapped Text & Basic Cloze
grammar: Verb + preposition collocations (depend on, interested in)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-009"
cando: "Can complete a gapped text choosing the correct grammar and vocabulary items."
strategy: "Timing: 7 mins for 10 gaps. Pitfall: Ignoring words immediately following the gap (e.g. prepositions). Criteria: Collocation and preposition accuracy in context."
lessons.recycled: Past continuous vs past simple, Adverbs of degree, Article, Attitude

lessons.title: B1 Reading & Language Strategy Review
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-010"
cando: "Can complete a 35-minute timed B1 reading module applying scanning and elimination techniques."
strategy: "Timing: 35 mins timed section. Pitfall: Spending over 2 mins on a single gapped item. Criteria: Pacing and accuracy across diverse text types."
lessons.recycled: Prepositions of place and time, Verb + preposition collocations, Context, Collocation

lessons.title: B1 Email & Essay Writing Structure
grammar: Formal vs informal greetings and closings
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-011"
cando: "Can structure short emails and essays following B1 exam criteria."
strategy: "Timing: 20 mins for email/essay draft. Pitfall: Combining informal slang with formal email formulas. Criteria: Content coverage, paragraph layout, and register consistency."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of B1 reading structures, Cohesive devices, Passage, Cohesion

lessons.title: B1 Writing: Informal Email & Requesting Information
grammar: Asking questions politely (Would it be possible to...?)
Future plans with going to and present continuous
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-012"
cando: "Can write a 100-word informal email replying to notes and asking for details."
strategy: "Timing: 20 mins total. Pitfall: Missing one of the required prompt bullet points. Criteria: Full task completion and friendly informal tone."
lessons.recycled: Connectors of addition and contrast, Formal vs informal greetings, Dear, Sincerely

lessons.title: B1 Writing: Formal Letter & Complaint Handling
grammar: Passive voice for polite complaints (I was informed that...)
Modal verbs for demands (I would appreciate a refund)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-013"
cando: "Can write a formal letter expressing dissatisfaction and requesting action."
strategy: "Timing: 25 mins. Pitfall: Using overly emotional language instead of polite formal phrasing. Criteria: Communicative achievement and formal style."
lessons.recycled: Asking questions politely, Future plans with going to, Suggest, Arrange

lessons.title: B1 Writing: Opinion Essay & Supporting Reasons
grammar: Expressing personal views (In my view, I strongly believe)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-014"
cando: "Can draft a structured 100-word opinion essay with introduction, points, and conclusion."
strategy: "Timing: 25 mins. Pitfall: Writing one long continuous block without paragraph structure. Criteria: Organization and clear logical progression."
lessons.recycled: Passive voice for complaints, Modal verbs for demands, Dissatisfied, Replacement

lessons.title: B1 Writing: Review & Marking Criteria Self-Assessment
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-015"
cando: "Can review and self-correct B1 written compositions against official exam rubrics."
strategy: "Timing: 5 mins proofreading stage after writing. Pitfall: Submitting without checking verb agreement and spelling. Criteria: Self-editing mastery and error reduction."
lessons.recycled: Expressing personal views, First conditional, Advantage, Disadvantage

lessons.title: B1 Photo Description & Long Turn Task
grammar: Present continuous for actions in pictures
Prepositions of position (in the foreground, on the left)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-016"
cando: "Can describe pictures and complete 1-minute long turns for B1 oral exams."
strategy: "Timing: 1-minute uninterrupted monologue. Pitfall: Stopping after 20 seconds or giving a list of isolated words. Criteria: Continuous spoken flow and positional vocabulary."
lessons.recycled: Self-correction and proofreading strategies, Punctuation rules, Criteria, Proofread

lessons.title: B1 Speaking: Describing Experiences & Personal Preferences
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-017"
cando: "Can talk about personal life, past experiences, and preferences fluently."
strategy: "Timing: 2 mins response. Pitfall: Repetitive use of basic verbs (like/good). Criteria: Lexical resource and grammatical range in personal topics."
lessons.recycled: Present continuous for actions in pictures, Prepositions of position, Foreground, Background

lessons.title: B1 Speaking: Collaborative Task & Negotiating Choices
grammar: Agreeing and disagreeing politely (I agree, but...)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-018"
cando: "Can interact with a partner to discuss choices, evaluate options, and reach a consensus."
strategy: "Timing: 2 mins discussion + 1 min decision. Pitfall: Monopolizing talk without asking for partner's opinion. Criteria: Interactive communication and collaborative turn-taking."
lessons.recycled: Used to for past habits, Would rather / Prefer, Hobby, Memorable

lessons.title: B1 Speaking: Discussion & Justifying Ideas
grammar: Because / As a result for giving reasons
Second conditional for imaginary scenarios (If I could, I would)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-019"
cando: "Can participate in a 3-minute discussion answering examiner questions on broader topics."
strategy: "Timing: 3 mins group discussion. Pitfall: Giving one-word answers (Yes/No) without elaboration. Criteria: Expanding answers with reasons and examples."
lessons.recycled: Suggestions, Agreeing and disagreeing politely, Option, Decision

lessons.title: B1 Speaking: Live Interview Simulation & Strategy Review
grammar: Hesitation and filler phrases (Let me see, That's an interesting question)
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-020"
cando: "Can complete a full 10-minute B1 pair speaking test simulation."
strategy: "Timing: 10-12 mins full test format. Pitfall: Freezing when an unknown word is encountered. Criteria: Global fluency, interactive communication, and pronunciation clarity."
lessons.recycled: Because / As a result, Second conditional, Reason, Justify

units.title: B1 Full Mock-Exam Practice & Skill Integration

lessons.title: B1 Mock Exam: Listening Paper Simulation
grammar: Comprehensive review of B1 listening structures
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-021"
cando: "Can complete a full timed B1 listening exam paper under formal test conditions."
strategy: "Timing: 30 mins audio test + 5 mins answer transfer. Pitfall: Leaving blanks on multiple-choice items. Criteria: Full listening mark calculation and error audit."
lessons.recycled: Synthesis of B1 spoken structures, Hesitation and filler phrases, Examiner, Fluency

lessons.title: B1 Mock Exam: Reading & Use of English Paper Simulation
grammar: Comprehensive review of B1 reading & grammar structures
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-022"
cando: "Can complete a full 45-minute B1 reading paper adhering strictly to time constraints."
strategy: "Timing: 45 mins limit. Pitfall: Mismanaging time between long text and short notices. Criteria: Scaled score evaluation across reading parts."
lessons.recycled: Comprehensive review of B1 listening, Mock exam, Answer sheet

lessons.title: B1 Mock Exam: Writing Paper Simulation & Self-Correction
grammar: Comprehensive review of B1 writing connectors and register
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-023"
cando: "Can complete two B1 writing tasks (email and essay) within 45 minutes."
strategy: "Timing: 45 mins for 2 tasks. Pitfall: Exceeding or falling severely short of word count (100 words each). Criteria: Assessment against official B1 writing criteria."
lessons.recycled: Comprehensive review of B1 reading, Time limit, Passage

lessons.title: B1 Mock Exam: Full Speaking Pair Test Simulation
grammar: Comprehensive review of B1 oral interaction structures
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-024"
cando: "Can perform all 4 parts of a live B1 oral examination with a peer and examiner."
strategy: "Timing: 12 mins complete oral exam. Pitfall: Breaking interaction and remaining silent. Criteria: Detailed assessment across Grammar, Vocabulary, Discourse, and Pronunciation."
lessons.recycled: Comprehensive review of B1 writing, Prompt, Word limit

lessons.title: B1 Exam Final Review: Timing Tactics, Pitfalls & Score Optimization
grammar: Integrated review of key B1 exam grammatical focus points
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-EXM-B1-025"
cando: "Can apply personalized test-taking strategies and avoid common pitfalls to maximize B1 exam score."
strategy: "Timing: Exam strategy breakdown. Pitfall: Anxiety-driven rush in initial test minutes. Criteria: Overall exam readiness and confidence optimization."
lessons.recycled: Comprehensive review of B1 oral interaction, Simulation, Prompt card
